chart_review.chart_window: 126 causal sessions before signal through 126 context sessions after signal, capped at 2021-06-30

economic_interpretation.mother_signal: An extreme PIT-industry one-session median move is a common-demand shock, not by itself an alpha signal.
economic_interpretation.compressed_mechanism: A demand shock is deployable when broad risk is already non-bearish or is causally repairing. Stock path is used only to admit economically coherent repair exceptions and veto obvious mature-distribution or structural-falling-knife states.
economic_interpretation.bull_bear_semantics: All market state and acceleration fields are observed at the signal close. No future market classification is used.

causal_features.market_regime: Existing frozen causal state using signal-date market_median_ret20, market_median_ret60, market_positive_ret20_share, and market_positive_ret60_share.
causal_features.stock_path: signal-date ret20, ret60, close_location, signal_turnover_ratio, and pre126_position, all ending at the signal close

rules.meaning: Broad absolute conditions are not simultaneously negative across both frozen horizons and breadth measures.
In a trailing bear state, both return and participation have improved from the 60-session scale to the 20-session scale.

A positive-industry demand shock hits a stock in the lower half of its causal six-month range while its 20-session path improves on its 60-session path and it closes in the upper half of the signal-day range.
rules.condition: direction_lane == 'CONTINUATION' and ret20 > ret60 and pre126_position <= 0.50 and close_location >= 0.50

rules.meaning: A stock selected from the weakest industry has positive 20-session stock return, is not in the upper 30% of its causal six-month range, and closes in the upper half of the signal-day range.
rules.condition: direction_lane == 'REVERSAL' and ret20 >= 0 and pre126_position <= 0.70 and close_location >= 0.50

rules.meaning: Reject either a mature high-inventory demand spike or a structural falling knife while market trend and breadth are still worsening.
rules.condition: (pre126_position >= 0.95 and ret20 >= 0.20 and signal_turnover_ratio >= 1.50) or (ret20 < ret60 and ret20 < 0 and market_return_acceleration <= 0 and market_breadth_acceleration <= 0)

frozen_admission: (R1_NON_BEAR_CORE or R2_CAUSAL_BEAR_REPAIR or R3_LOW_INVENTORY_PRICE_DISCOVERY_EXCEPTION or R4_WEAK_INDUSTRY_STOCK_RESILIENCE_EXCEPTION) and not R5_STRUCTURAL_TRAP_VETO

threshold_rationale.zero: Direction and acceleration sign, not an optimized percentile.
threshold_rationale.0.50: Range midpoint / upper-half close: canonical balance boundary.
threshold_rationale.0.70: Exclude only the upper 30% inventory region for the resilience exception.
threshold_rationale.0.20: Mature 20-session advance of at least 20%, economically large rather than a neighboring search.
threshold_rationale.1.50: Signal turnover at least 1.5 times prior-20 median, a broad abnormal-activity threshold.

evaluation.entry: First legal non-limit-up open in signal+1 through signal+3.
evaluation.exit: +10% coordinate target or first legal sellable open at H20.
evaluation.pass_gate: For every development signal year 2014-2020: completed events > 50 and mean net return > 0.04.
evaluation.later_period_policy: Read 2022-2024 signal/outcome data only if the complete per-year development gate passes. Otherwise close this exact chart-derived formulation without threshold rescue.

governance.corporate_action_coordinate_contract: unchanged from frozen mother Stage B
